title: Verify your ID

reasons.staff_request: Our team asked for an ID check on your account. Posting and booking wait until it passes.
reasons.reports: We've had reports about this account, so we need to check your ID before you post or book again.
reasons.failed_payments: Several card payments didn't go through today, so we need to check your ID before you pay again.
reasons.new_account_large_booking: Your account is new, so bookings of $500 or more need an ID check first.
reasons.none: Clients only need an ID check when we ask for one.

explanation: Our ID partner asks for a photo of your ID and a selfie. It takes about 2 minutes.
privacy: Helpers never see your ID. We keep only that it passed, and when.
processing: We're checking your ID. It usually takes a few minutes, and we'll let you know when it's done.
nameCheck: Your ID passed, but the name on it is different from your account's. Our team is checking, and we'll let you know.
verified: Your ID is verified. You can carry on.
notNeeded: You don't need an ID check right now.
